verdicts.title: On a class of Feynman integrals evaluating to iterated integrals of modular forms
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this talk we discuss a class of Feynman integrals, which can be expressed to all orders in the dimensional regularisation parameter as iterated integrals of modular forms. We review the mathematical prerequisites related to elliptic curves and modular forms. verdicts.title: Concomitants of Ternary Quartics and Vector-valued Siegel and Teichmüller Modular Forms of Genus Three
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We show how one can use the representation theory of ternary quartics to construct all vector-valued Siegel modular forms and Teichmüller modular forms of degree 3. The relation between the order of vanishing of a concomitant on the locus of double conics and the order of vanishing of the corresponding modular form on the hyperelliptic locus plays an important role.
